description: Create a 2D kinematic simulation of an ABB IRB 120 robot arm in GeoGebra. The arm has two links: Link 1 (Lower Arm) = 290 mm, Link 2 (Upper Arm) = 302 mm. You must: 1. Adjust the view to work in millimeters (zoom out to visible range ~700mm). 2. Create a fixed Base point at (0,0). 3. Create a draggable Target point. 4. Geometrically construct the 'Elbow' point such that the arm reaches the target (using intersection of circles). 5. Connect the points with segments to visualize the arm. 6. Draw the maximum workspace boundary (radius 592mm). Save the file as 'robot_kinematics.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
